handoff.purpose: Collect candidates from multiple sources (work_queue, map, docref, inventory, eval_baseline, eval_gate, hotspots) with error handling and source metadata.

claims.text: Never raises out of build_queue: the contract is 'never raises on a bad or missing source', and an optional enrichment is the last thing that should be allowed to take the queue down.
claims.why: The claim refers to the behaviour of spectral_mod.analyse and the overall build_queue function, both of which are outside this chunk.

claims.text: A hand-edited generated file is worse than a missing one: it looks authoritative. Withheld for the same reason the inventory is, and said out loud for the same reason.
claims.why: The claim describes a design rationale that is not checkable against the code in this chunk.

claims.text: Derived every run, so unlike the map and the inventory it has no snapshot that can go stale and no digest to verify -- the scan IS the measurement, taken now, against this tree.
claims.why: The claim refers to the docref source's freshness property, which cannot be verified from this chunk alone.

claims.text: Never raises (docrefs.scan promises that); a failure here must cost the queue this one source, never the whole queue.
claims.why: The claim references docrefs.scan's promise, which is outside this chunk.

claims.text: Reported, not swallowed: a source that failed is a different fact from a source that found nothing, and a queue that hides the difference is the shape this repo keeps finding in stale artifacts.
claims.why: The code catches Exception, records the error in sources['docref'] with state 'error', and appends a note, thus reporting the failure rather than swallowing it.

claims.text: FAIL CLOSED. Letting a snapshot of a different tree drive these bands means working from a repo that no longer exists.
claims.why: The code suppresses inventory candidates when freshness is not fresh and enforce_inventory_freshness is True, failing closed as described.

observations.what: Function _collect_candidates is not defined in this chunk; this chunk appears to be the body of that function.

Multiple external functions are called without visible imports: load_work_queue, work_queue_candidates, _project_config, _picker_source_mode, load_map_state, map_state_trustworthy, map_candidates, docrefs.scan, docref_candidates, load_inventory, inventory_candidates, inventory_freshness, _load_baseline, eval_baseline_candidates, _run_eval_gate, eval_gate_candidates, _load_index, hotspot_candidates.
The chunk ends mid-statement at line 2515 with an 'else:' clause that is incomplete.
The variable 'root' is assigned from Path(repo_root).resolve() if repo_root else ROOT. If ROOT is not defined or not a valid path, this could cause an error.
The variable 'project_config' is used but its type and contents are not shown; it is assumed to be a dict-like object.
